title: File friction after the polish_done event, not before it
body:
**Chose:** `file_friction` runs right after `PolishDone` is emitted, before `polish` returns.
**Over:** between `commit_polish` and the `PolishDone` emit, as the slice's ":325" placement reads.
**Because:** a driver that dies between filing and the event re-enters polish and would file a second `-2` idea; after the event, a death files nothing, which FR-7 already accepts.
**Undo:** move the one call line above `run.emit(EventKind::PolishDone …)`.

title: init output when the skills or one convention file were not written
body:
**Chose:** the commit subject carries `(skills <version>)` only when `init` rendered the skills this run; otherwise it is `chore: factory init`. When `CLAUDE.md` links to `AGENTS.md`, the `convention block:` line and the `git add` list name the link's target (`AGENTS.md`), not the link.
**Over:** always printing the version in the subject (a lie on a source checkout or a repo whose skills `update` owns); naming the link, which `git add` would stage unchanged while the real edit went uncommitted.
**Because:** the slice fixed the full-run output but was silent on partial runs; the printed line must commit exactly what changed.
**Undo:** `src/docs/scaffold.rs` `init` (`subject`) and `convention` (`shown`).

title: review second: renames, an empty diff, and killing the reviewer's group
body:
**Chose:** `--no-renames` on the numstat and on each pass's diff, so a rename is a delete plus an add and every path is one plain file name; an empty diff against the base prints `unreviewed: no changes against <base>` and exits 2; each child runs in its own process group and a timeout SIGKILLs the group; the probe's output goes to `list-models.txt` in the log dir and `log: <dir>` follows an `unreviewed:` line too.
**Over:** parsing `old => new` numstat paths; exit 0 on nothing to review; killing only the direct child, which leaves a wrapper script's node process running and spending quota.
**Because:** the slice was silent on all four; each is the choice that cannot read as a clean review or leak a reviewer.
**Undo:** drop `--no-renames` in `src/review.rs` `numstat`/`diff`; change the early return in `src/cli/review.rs`; remove `process_group(0)` and the `libc::kill` line in `run_logged`.

title: tests/review.rs runs the stub at a 20 s timeout except the timeout test
body:
**Chose:** `[review] timeout_secs = 2` only in `a_timeout_keeps_the_partial_text`; the other fixtures write 20.
**Over:** 2 s in every fixture, as the slice's acceptance line reads.
**Because:** the probe and every pass run under the same timeout, so a node start-up slowed by a parallel `cargo test` past 2 s would turn a replay into a kill and flake the three-pass test. The timeout behaviour itself is still proven at 2 s.
**Undo:** pass 2 to `fixture(...)` in every test.

title: src/config.rs holds slice 05's [source] beside [review]
body:
**Chose:** add `[review]` on top of the working tree's `src/config.rs`, which already carried slice 05's uncommitted `[source]` (`TOP_KEYS` now lists both, as the slice said the two lines merge).
**Over:** reverting slice 05's lines to keep this slice's diff pure.
**Because:** the slice-05 commit (393ddbd) left `src/closeout.rs`, `src/config.rs`, `src/docs/preflight.rs` and `tests/stubs/claude` modified in the tree; removing them would break slice 05. This slice's commit may therefore carry slice 05's `[source]` hunks.
**Undo:** none needed; split the hunks by hand if the history matters.

title: after slice-05
body:
**Covers:** slices 01, 02, 04, 05
**Gate:** 1 run, 0 red, 1.1 min — caught: nothing (it runs on the working tree, so it could not see that HEAD did not compile)
**Prove:** 5 of 5 machine rows driven; the 2 human rows (FR-2 in `arca-api`, FR-6 after `cursor-agent login`) are the owner's, after the merge — evidence:
- FR-1: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-fr1-bundle-green.txt` (3 passed), `cp-1-fr1-grep.txt` (empty), `cp-1-fr1-bundle-red.txt` (red naming `prd/references/x.md`, then removed)
- FR-1 `models.md` bullet: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-fr1-models-grep.txt` (empty)
- FR-2 machine: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-fr2-init.txt` (real binary, both stdouts, `ls -la .agents/skills`, porcelain, manifest head, replaced `polish/SKILL.md` sha256 equal to the manifest's), `cp-1-fr2-init-tests.txt` (8 passed)
- FR-6 stub: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-fr6-review-tests.txt` (8 passed)
- FR-6 live: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-fr6-live.txt` (`unreviewed: … Authentication required`, log path, exit 2: a pass by the row), `cp-1-fr6-live-list-models.err`
- FR-7: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-fr7-friction-tests.txt` (3 passed; idea file text; porcelain `?? docs/ideas/2026-10-13-friction-repo-prd-001.md`)
**Fixed:** the slice commits 9eed991, 34d9bca and 393ddbd left their source in the tree, and HEAD did not compile (`docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-head-build.txt`: 18 missing `skills/` files, no `crate::review`, no `Config.review`). This checkpoint claims them for its commit: the 18 `skills/` files, the nine `.claude/skills/` links, `src/lib.rs`, `src/closeout.rs`, `src/config.rs`, `src/docs/preflight.rs` (rustfmt only), `tests/stubs/claude`. The staged tree, checked out alone, passes `cargo check --all-targets` and the bundle, review and init tests: `docs/features/004-skills/evidence/cp-1-index-build.txt`. Root cause parked as idea `2026-10-13-slice-commits-drop-files-the-worker-claimed-by-dir` (high).

title: slice 07 writes the integer version parser that slice 03 now uses, and shares src/skills.rs with it
body:
**Chose:** `skills::version_parts` (three `u64`s, `None` on anything else, pre-release suffixes included) written in this slice; slice 03, building beside it in another lane, already calls it from `verdict_for`. This slice's `src/skills.rs` therefore sits in one file with slice 03's uncommitted `Version`, `Verdict` and `remove_dropped` hunks, and whichever slice commits first carries both.
**Over:** waiting for slice 03's parser, which the slice assumed existed but did not exist when this slice started.
**Because:** the two slices ran at once; one parser is what both slices asked for.
**Undo:** none needed; split the `src/skills.rs` hunks by hand if the history matters.

title: the bundle lock is read once per test binary through a OnceLock
body:
**Chose:** `tests/skills_bundle.rs` reads, checks, or (with `FACTORY_BUNDLE_WRITE`) rewrites the lock once inside a `OnceLock`, and both `bundle_lock_matches` and the manifest test use that result.
**Over:** each test reading the lock file on its own.
**Because:** cargo runs the two in parallel, so the manifest test could read a half-written lock during a write run.
**Undo:** inline the helper into `bundle_lock_matches` and read the file in the manifest test.

title: skills update on an unreadable manifest, and manifest paths outside the skills dirs
body:
**Chose:** `factory skills update` on an `unreadable` manifest prints the doctor line and exits 1, writing nothing; `remove_dropped` skips any old-manifest path that is not plain names (no `..`, no root) and any `[links]` key outside `.agents/skills/`.
**Over:** re-rendering over an unreadable manifest (the dropped files would be invisible), or deleting whatever path a hand-written manifest names.
**Because:** the slice was silent on both; each choice cannot delete a file outside the two skills dirs or lose track of what the old bundle held.
**Undo:** `src/cli/skills.rs` `update` (the `Verdict::Unreadable` arm) and `src/skills.rs` `plain`.

title: src/skills.rs is shared with slice 07, building beside this slice
body:
**Chose:** add the verdict, `read_manifest` and `remove_dropped` to `src/skills.rs` next to slice 07's uncommitted `Lock`, `version_parts`, `check_lock` and `relock`, and compare versions with slice 07's `version_parts`, not a second parser.
**Over:** a private version parser in this slice, or reverting slice 07's lines to keep this diff pure.
**Because:** `state.toml` shows slice 07 building in lane 2 on the same tree, and it had already written a `version_parts` that does exactly FR-3's integer comparison. The working tree also carries slice 07's `Cargo.toml` bump to 0.2.0; every test here builds versions from `CARGO_PKG_VERSION`, so it passes either way.
**Undo:** none needed; this slice's commit may carry slice 07's `src/skills.rs` hunks, or slice 07's may carry these.
